notes:
Lead source: inbound self-serve signup, activated hosted API trial.

Customer goal: embed a streaming support-agent in their web app that calls backend tools (create_ticket, lookup_kb) via function/tool-calling. Needs structured JSON output from model so client can call tool endpoints in real time.

What they see: model streaming emits fragmented JSON across delta events. Frontend tries to JSON.parse(accumulatedText) and gets errors when object is incomplete or when trailing commas appear. Also occasional mismatch between function schema and returned payload — e.g. schema expects 'ticket_id' number but model returns "12345" (string) or returns {"actions": null} instead of empty array.

Customer quotes: "Looks fine in quick demos, but in our real chat sessions the UI crashes parsing the stream — very hard to handle in production."

Repro details provided by customer: minimal JS (fetch + ReadableStream) + Redwood hosted API streaming. They attached a sample transcript where stream events include partial text: first chunk '{"request":{"ticket_id":' then next chunk '"12345","status":"open"}}'. Also a chunk contains an extra comma before closing brace which breaks parsing.

Immediate asks: 1) quick troubleshooting checklist for streaming + function calling; 2) sample robust client pattern to accumulate and safely parse streamed structured output; 3) recommendations to reduce model-side schema mismatch (prompt templates, stricter function schema, JSON mode flags).

Sales signal: SMB, likely low ARR but good reference for hosted API UX. Churn risk if unresolved quickly — primary blocker is perceived instability of streaming structured output.

Suggested partial fixes discussed on call: - use explicit structured-output instruction (JSON-only wrapper) in prompt, add 'output_schema' hints; - coerce types in prompt examples ("ticket_id": 12345) and add explicit 'required' list; - add short buffering on client to only attempt parse after closing '}' or matching brackets; - use Redwood SDK streaming helpers (SE provided sample) instead of raw fetch; - if problems persist, capture streaming debug token and enable full trace for INF team.

Next internal items: SE to provide code sample + small sanity-check harness; Engineering may escalate if we see model producing invalid JSON consistently (ticket INF-2241).
